title: Hugh Hefner alerted FBI about Epstein; alleged rape victim, Playboy Playmate, contacted 15 years later: Report
content:
• Playboy founder Hugh Hefner personally alerted the FBI in 2005 about Jeffrey Epstein's alleged abuse of former Playboy Playmate Audra Lynn Christiansen.
• The FBI reportedly did not follow up with alleged victim Audra Lynn Christiansen until October 2020, nearly 15 years after Hugh Hefner's initial report.
• The allegations are part of an amended complaint filed in May by 32 Jeffrey Epstein victims in the US District Court for the Southern District of Florida.

title: I-Day: Delhi Police honoured with 17 medals, including 2 President's Medals
content:
• On Independence Day, 17 Delhi Police personnel were honoured with service medals, including 2 President's Medals for Distinguished Service (PSM) and 15 Medals for Meritorious Service (MSM).
• Additional Commissioner of Police Dinesh Kumar Gupta, a 2010-batch IPS officer, was awarded the President's Medal for Distinguished Service (PSM).
• S K Shokeen, Commandant (Home Guards), DG Home Guards, also received the President's Medal for Distinguished Service (PSM).

title: Trump asks Supreme Court to allow White House ballroom construction to continue
content:
• A Washington appeals court on 7 August upheld a federal judge’s decision to prevent above-ground construction work on the White House ballroom project.
• The White House ballroom project is funded by $400 million in private donations, with no taxpayer funds being used.
• The project is 65% complete, featuring a superstructure five stories deep and 70 feet high, with a 250-person crew working 20 hours a day.

title: India's position on Indus Waters Treaty unchanged, says MEA after Pak PM's 'water is our red line' remark
content:
• The Indus Waters Treaty, governing the sharing of waters of the Indus river system between India and Pakistan, was signed in September 1960.
• India put the Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance following a Cabinet Committee on Security meeting on 23 April 2025, days after the 22 April Pahalgam terror attack in which 26 civilians were killed, stating it would remain in abeyance until Pakistan ends support for cross-border terrorism.
• Pakistan Prime Minister's Office, through PM Sharif, accused India of 'unilaterally and illegally' suspending the Indus Waters Treaty and declared 'every drop of Pakistan's water is our red line', asserting no compromise on the water issue.

title: Internship scheme aims to bridge skill gap among youth: Nirmala Sitharaman
content:
• The government has increased the monthly stipend for its internship scheme to ₹9,000 from ₹5,000 for the ongoing third phase, which started in March.
• The minimum eligible age for the internship scheme has been reduced to 18 years from 21, and the internship duration has been revised to six or nine months from one year.
• The Corporate Affairs Ministry is implementing the internship scheme, and final-year undergraduate students are now eligible to apply.

title: Wholesale inflation eases to 9.8% on softer energy prices
content:
• Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation eased to 9.8% in July 2025.
• Retail inflation edged up to 4.5% year-on-year in July from 4.4% in June.
• Food inflation rose to a 19-month high of 6.6% in July from 6.1% in June.

title: Forex reserves soar to $707 billion, highest so far in current fiscal
content:
• India's forex reserves soared to $707 billion, the highest so far in the current fiscal.
• The RBI shortened the swap facility window by a month, making it valid until August 31.
• India received $56.8 billion in foreign currency inflows under the RBI's special deposit scheme, with FCNR(B) deposits contributing $52 billion and FCNR-B and ECB schemes now valid until August 31.

title: RBI may stay nimble on rates as growth is seen slowing to 6.6%: Report
content:
• According to a Crisil report, India's GDP growth is projected to slow to 6.6% this fiscal, down from 7.7% in the last fiscal.
• India recorded net Foreign Portfolio Investor (FPI) inflows of USD 4.2 billion in July, which was the highest since September 2024, with the equity segment registering its first net inflow in five months.
• In July, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) absorbed an average systemic liquidity surplus of Rs 1.07 lakh crore (0.4% of NDTL), and the yield on the benchmark 10-year bond fell to 6.77%.

title: Global energy, weather risks threaten further easing in wholesale inflation: Economists
content:
• The Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation rate stood at 9.78 per cent in July 2026, down marginally from 9.87 per cent in June 2026.
• Fuel and power inflation significantly moderated to 20.05 per cent in July 2026 from 27.41 per cent in June 2026.
• ICRA Principal Economist Rahul Agrawal expects WPI inflation to ease below 9.5 per cent in August 2026, after peaking at 9.9 per cent in May-June 2026, forecasting an average WPI inflation of around 8.5 per cent for FY2027.

title: RBI shortens FCNR (B) deposit swap window to Aug 31
content:
• The RBI has shortened the swap facility for FCNR(B) deposits, making it available only for deposits mobilized till August 31, 2026, and swaps may be availed till September 11, 2026.
• The swap scheme for External Commercial Borrowings (ECBs) and Overseas Foreign Currency Borrowings (OFCBs) will continue as originally planned until December 31, 2026.
• Total foreign inflows from the special measures announced by RBI stood at $56.84 billion until August 13, with FCNR(B) deposits accounting for $52.30 billion of these inflows.
